Northwind Analytics reports fiscal 2025 results

Northwind Analytics reported revenue of $48 million for fiscal 2025, up 31% from the prior year.

The company's engineers rebuilt the billing platform during the spring, and the new system now handles every customer invoice.

Chief executive Dana Okafor said the company would open a second office in Lisbon next year and expects to hire about 40 people there.

The board approved a Series B extension led by existing investors. No new investors joined the round.
